messages.author: 5b0c9158bfa781ba
messages.subject: Shiny Server and package locations
parts:
Hello,

Shiny server is even more impressive. Thanks. I have a setup as follows:

A centos6 VM with a user "sguha". I have installed R in my home folder (i.e. i downloaded it, compiled and installed in my own folder)
and R_LIBS is in my home folder. Moreover my .bash_profile needs to be loaded.

Shiny package has been installed. And this is my shiny-server.conf file[1]
 
When i go to http://centos6/user/sguha/test1

where test1 contains server.R and ui.R from the tutorial I get (though i have shiny installed)

The application failed to start.

The application exited during initialization.

Error in library(shiny) : there is no package called 'shiny' Execution halted


[1]

run_as sguha;
log_dir /var/log/shiny-server/;

server {
  listen 80;

  location /users {
    user_apps on;
  }
}

messages.author: 5b0c9158bfa781ba
messages.subject: Re: Shiny Server and package locations
parts:
I forgot to say, I ran shiny as

messages.subject: Re: Shiny Server and package locations
parts:
Thanks for the prompt reply. Yes, it's mostly environment variables, for example

export PREFIX=$HOME/software
export PKG_CONFIG_PATH=$PKG_CONFIG_PATH:$PREFIX/lib/pkgconfig/
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$PREFIX/lib/:$PREFIX/lib64:$PREFIX/lib64//R/lib
export PATH=$PREFIX/bin/:$PATH:/usr/local/maven
export R_LIBS=$PREFIX/R_LIBS
export HADOOP=/usr/
export TERM=xterm
export JAVA_PREFIX=/usr/lib/jvm/java-sun
export R_HOME=$PREFIX/lib64/R
export R_HOME_DIR=$PREFIX/lib64/R
export HADOOP_HOME=/usr/lib/hadoop
export HADOOP_CONF_DIR=/etc/hadoop/conf

However, upon
sudo restart shiny-server, same error
Error in library(shiny) : there is no package called 'shiny' Execution halted

Thanks for your time on this
Saptarshi
